summary: A Chelsea and Earls Court independent estate agency appears to lose valuation enquiries to a thin homepage, no visible proof and no WhatsApp.

findings.problem: The homepage text appears to be very short, with only a small welcome paragraph and a menu.
findings.cost: Owners choosing an agent want to see areas, results and people before they call.
findings.fix: A fuller homepage with areas, team and recent results.

findings.problem: No reviews, sold results or testimonials appear on the homepage.
findings.cost: Sellers choose the agent who shows proof.

findings.problem: A menu item called Tiger Cubs appears with no explanation.
findings.fix: A clear label such as Graduate Programme.

findings.problem: A stray markup character group appears in the page text and no WhatsApp appears.
findings.cost: Broken code looks careless and clients cannot message quickly.
findings.fix: Clean markup and WhatsApp on every page.
